desc:
🛒 Your store. Your hustle. Open 25 hours!

Warung Madura is a store management simulator set in a lively Indonesian neighborhood.

🛒 Serve customers and keep your shelves stocked.
🍢 Prepare local favorites like sate, gorengan, and es teh.
💵 Earn Rupiah and turn your small warung into a thriving business.
🏪 Expand your store and upgrade your equipment.
👷 Hire workers to help run your warung.
⚡ Handle Rush Hour, unexpected events, and special encounters.
🌦️ Experience changing weather and the neighborhood from day to night.
🎁 Claim daily rewards and keep growing your business!

❤️ Enjoying the game? Like and favorite to support us!
👥 Join Confy Studio for community news and updates.

Developed & Curated by @confydential
